payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing the SubGram and Skip-gram models, indicating the gains obtained by the SubGram model over the Skip-gram model.

claims.text: The SubGram model outperforms the Skip-gram model on the same training set, achieving 22.4% accuracy compared to 9.7% for Skip-gram.
The performance of the SubGram model on out-of-vocabulary (OOV) words is an improvement over the Skip-gram model, which scored zero.
The Skip-gram model trained on a larger dataset achieved a performance of 43.5%, which is higher than the SubGram's performance on the original test set.
